title: PDF parsing configuration v1
description: Go/RE2 regex patterns; one-based capture groups. All markers must match, exactly one date and table are allowed, and every non-whitespace table character must belong to a complete row. Template version is stored separately in the database. Email selectors live on the template record, not in config.

layout.description: Go time layout including a full year, month and day. Parsed date must round-trip exactly.

fields.description: Distinct existing capture groups are required for all six fields, including zero-valued buy/sell cells.

numbers.description: Unsigned ASCII digits only. Separators must be distinct single non-alphanumeric, non-whitespace characters other than +, - or /. Thousands separator may be empty. Grouping is strictly validated; exponents and signs are forbidden.

shares_per_lot.description: quantity = lot * shares_per_lot; positive integral lot and quantity. Exactly one side amount is positive and equals quantity * price exactly (before any fees).
